void
  ui_error_popup_preserve (int fd, terminal_size_t size)


Preserve pending notifications using cached terminal dimensions
    before queue retirement. Callers own an interactive terminal and must
    prevent concurrent rendering. This formatter performs no console queries and
    does not wait for input.
